en: Black‑and‑white image of a waterfront bathing or leisure pavilion built on piles over the water, with ornate wooden balconies, many windows with curtains and striped awnings. In the foreground is a wooden pier and a small floating platform with a moored buoy. Behind the pavilion rise wooden villas on a hillside and, further back, a tall spired church dominating the skyline. The scene suggests a northern European seaside resort town. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image.
